text:
nora: Quick triage request: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4402 failed docs-preview. Linkcheck reports a broken anchor, and md-lint warns about unordered list style. Need to get this merged before tomorrow's sync.

liam: Which file/anchor?

nora: /reference/cli/commands.md -> anchor used in cross-link is #deploy-flags but the heading was changed to 'flags' -> anchor #flags. LinkCheckError shows: 
```
LinkCheckError: /reference/cli/commands.md: anchor not found: deploy-flags
  in /reference/cli/commands.md: line 210
```

olga: I can push a tiny patch to update the xref to #flags on nora's branch. Also saw MD004 (list style) in /guides/ops/runbooks.md line 34.

nora: Great, please include a brief commit message like "fix: docs link xref and list style". Keep edits minimal.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #589 failed 00: LinkCheckError(1), MD004(1).

liam: For the list style, we should prefer consistent "-" bullets. I'll convert the couple of "*" entries to "-" and wrap a long sentence to satisfy MD013. Won't touch code fences.

olga: Pushed commit f3d21 to update the anchor and fixed an obvious typo. Re-running preview.

docs-bot: New commit on PR 4402 by olga. Triggering preview...

ci-bot: docs-preview build #590 queued.

liam: I have a tiny commit ready for MD004/MD013. Will push once olga's preview passes.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #590 succeeded.

liam: Pushed lint fixes.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #591 queued.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #591 succeeded.

nora: Can someone approve and merge by noon PT? I have the release checklist open.

olga: Approved.

liam: Merging via GitHub UI (fast-forward).

docs-bot: PR 4402 merged by liam at 1745500280.

nora: Thanks all. I'll monitor the site crawl tonight and post if anything else crops up. :shipit:
